_comment: Clips for the landing 'reel' band (light 'AI factory' video wall). generate.cjs renders each shot with MiniMax H3 on the Unsloth Studio server; build-reel.cjs writes the band into public/index.html. first_frame is relative to public/ and is fitted to 9:16 (fit 'contain' pads with the section background #eef2f7) before it is sent. seed is fixed and unique per shot so the progress result can be matched to the job. Prompts keep scenes bright and daylit to match the light page; Thai lines stay under ~5 s.

The glowing light-blue conveyor line on the tiled floor starts moving: small square product photos glide along it into the shop door, and moments later glossy vertical phone screens with a white play button pop out above the roof one by one and float upward.
